review_notes: I read the whole file. I grepped Mathlib for other uses and declarations of fintypeOfOption, Option.finite_iff, Option.infinite_iff, univ_option and Fintype (Option …) instances. I found no independent competing definition of any of these concepts. The Fintype/Finite instances for Option are the canonical ones, and the other files only reuse them via inferInstanceAs. fintypeOfOption and fintypeOfOptionEquiv are named converses, not parallel versions of an existing structure. truncRecEmptyOption, Fintype.induction_empty_option and Finite.induction_empty_option are the same induction principle at three levels: Trunc-valued data, Prop with Fintype, and Prop with Finite. Collapsing them would be theorem-level duplication, which the rubric excludes. I did not search every Mathlib file for a hidden duplicate of the recursor. I judged the case for consolidation unclear, so I abstain.
